regions.label: INesHeader
regions.evidence: Validated iNES header; PRG/CHR section sizes and MMC1 mapper decoded by rom.info.

regions.label: ChrTileGraphics
regions.evidence: CHR ROM section declared by validated iNES header, 8192 16-byte NES 2bpp tiles; immutable CHR data, separate from CPU PRG space.
